name: maxio-sdk-ts
description: Integrate and consume the APIMatic-generated Maxio Advanced Billing TypeScript SDK, grounded in the SDK map that ships inside the installed package. Bundles the integrate-maxio workflow router, the SDK-specific getting-started lookup layer, and seven API-agnostic TypeScript companions: client initialization, authentication, calling endpoints, models, error handling, configuration and resilience, and testing. No MCP server.
